title: 第15章 淬体境中期
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
回到出租屋。

    陈峰打开笔记本电脑，插入U盘。

    文件夹里一共三十六节视频课程，另有几份文字资料。

    他先点开了总纲性质的文档，粗略扫了一遍。

    灵药学的核心原理并不复杂。

    通过经验和感知，控制灵材中灵气的涌动方向，在关键节点加入辅料中和引导，稳定，最终将灵材调制成可安全服用的药剂。

    但实操起来难度很高，灵气的流动方向肉眼不可见，全凭修行者的感知去捕捉。

    稍有判断失误，轻则变成毒药，重则变成炸弹伤人。

    这也是官方严格管控灵药学的主要原因。

    而且，普通人想学这门手艺，最大的瓶颈不是课程，而是材料。

    现实世界的灵材本就稀少，大多数都是从禁区中产出，价格高昂。

    没有大量灵材供你反复试错，光看课程视频等于纸上谈兵。

    不过陈峰对此倒是无所谓。

    他现在手头有二十一株幼年血根草，两株半成年期，一株成年期。

    恐怕那些实验室里的灵药学研究生，能练习使用的血根草实验材料，都没有他多。

    而且就算不够，

    大不了他下次再进入进入大墟世界里收集。

    陈峰稍微翻了翻，没有贪多嚼不烂地去学全部课程。

    而是直接翻找跟血根草相关的章节，找到了第九课《常见燥性灵材的基础调制》。

    点开视频，开始学。

    ……

    接下来的七天。

    陈峰的生活被压缩成两件事。

    修行，和炼药。

    白天，服用半株半成年期血根草，配合七步导息法修行，提升体质。

    经过七天的苦修后，他的体质已经成功提升到12.8，单臂力量直逼五百斤。

    晚上，则对着视频课程反复研究，然后动手尝试调配。

    血根草燥性的去除，关键在于用动物性灵材中的活性脂质来中和。

    课程中提到了几种常见的动物灵材可以作为辅料，其中就包括低阶异化虫类的心脏组织。

    铁鄂灰蜚的心脏，正好能用。

    前五次尝试，全部失败。

    三次是灵气涌动方向判断出错，药液直接变质发黑。

    一次是辅料加入时机太晚，血根草的燥性已经扩散，整瓶药变成了废液。

    还有一次差点炸了，好在量小，只是瓶子碎了。

    而直到第六次。

    陈峰将铁鄂灰蜚心脏中的活性脂质提取出来，在血根草药液刚开始翻涌的瞬间精准注入，右手食指抵住瓶壁，感知着内部灵气的流转。

    三秒后，翻涌平息。

    药液从浑浊的暗红色变成了清澈的淡红色，表面泛着一层细密的光泽。

    成了！
content_en:
Return to the rental house.

    Chen Feng opened his laptop and inserted the USB flash drive.

    There are a total of thirty-six video lessons in the folder, as well as several written materials.

    He first clicked on the general document and scanned it roughly.

    The core principles of elixirology are not complicated.

    Through experience and perception, the direction of the spiritual energy in the spiritual materials is controlled, auxiliary materials are added at key nodes to neutralize and guide, stabilize, and finally the spiritual materials are prepared into potions that are safe to take.

    However, it is very difficult to operate in practice. The direction of the flow of spiritual energy is invisible to the naked eye and depends entirely on the practitioner's perception to capture it.

    A slight misjudgment can turn into poison at least, or a bomb to hurt people at worst.

    This is also the main reason why the government strictly controls spiritual medicine.

    Moreover, if ordinary people want to learn this craft, the biggest bottleneck is not the courses, but the materials.

    Spiritual materials in the real world are scarce. Most of them are produced from restricted areas and are expensive.

    There are not a lot of spiritual materials for you to try and make mistakes over and over again. Just watching the course videos is equivalent to talking on paper.

    But Chen Feng didn't care about this.

    He currently has twenty-one young bloodroot plants on hand, two semi-adult plants and one adult plant.

    I'm afraid that none of the spiritual medicine graduate students in the laboratory can practice using bloodroot experimental materials as much as he does.

    And even if it’s not enough,

    At worst, he will enter the world of Daxu next time to collect it.

    Chen Feng flipped through the pages a little, and did not bite off more than he could chew and learn all the courses.

    Instead, he directly searched for chapters related to bloodroot and found the ninth lesson "Basic Preparation of Common Dry Spirit Materials".

    Click on the video and start learning.

    …

    for the next seven days.

    Chen Feng's life was compressed into two things.

    Cultivation, and refining medicine.

    During the day, take half a semi-adult bloodroot plant and practice the seven-step breathing method to improve your physical fitness.

    After seven days of hard training, his physical fitness has been successfully improved to 12.8, and his one-arm strength is almost 500 kilograms.

    In the evening, I studied the video courses repeatedly, and then tried to make adjustments.

    The key to removing the dryness of bloodroot is to neutralize it with active lipids in animal spiritual materials.

    The course mentioned several common animal spiritual materials that can be used as supplementary materials, including the heart tissue of low-level alienated insects.

    The heart of Tie Jia Hui Fei is just right for use.

    The first five attempts, all failed.

    Three times, the direction of the spiritual energy surge was misjudged, and the medicine liquid directly deteriorated and turned black.

    One time, the excipients were added too late, and the dryness of the bloodroot had spread, turning the entire bottle of medicine into waste liquid.

    Another time it almost exploded, but fortunately the quantity was small, but the bottle was broken.

    And not until the sixth time.

    Chen Feng extracted the active lipids from the heart of the Tie E Hui Fei and injected it precisely at the moment when the blood root herbal liquid began to surge. He pressed his right index finger against the wall of the bottle and felt the flow of spiritual energy inside.

    Three seconds later, the surge subsided.

    The medicinal liquid changed from turbid dark red to clear light red, with a fine sheen on the surface.

    Done!
